project_type: SvelteKit 5 (runes) + TypeScript + Tailwind static/PWA public frontend (Public/frontend-v6), the live chhath.shaharpura.com app
build_system: Vite 8 (rolldown) via SvelteKit adapter-static; npm scripts
test_framework: vitest 5 — default environment 'node' for pure TS; component tests opt in per file with the '// @vitest-environment jsdom' pragma and use svelte's mount/unmount/flushSync (see src/lib/components/ContributorDetail.test.ts). Test glob: src/**/*.{test,spec}.{js,ts}
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run build
test_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test
verification_instructions: From Public/frontend-v6: (1) npm ci (deps already installed). (2) npm run check — svelte-check --fail-on-warnings, MUST stay 0 errors / 0 warnings. (3) npm test — vitest run, all green including new linkify tests. (4) npm run build — must succeed and total client JS must stay < 700000 bytes. Measure total with: find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}'. Baseline before this task = 622183 bytes (~77KB headroom).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. build/ is generated output (gitignored). No snapshot fixtures.
setup_instructions: PREPEND to PATH: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (node v22.23.2). node_modules already present; run npm ci in Public/frontend-v6 only if needed.
environment_constraints: Scope ALL changes to Public/frontend-v6 ONLY. Do NOT touch Public/frontend-v2..v5 or mgmt/. CI job 'public-frontend-v6' enforces total client JS budget <= 700000 bytes AND a per-page first-load budget (scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000). Prefer a tiny dependency-free implementation. IMPORTANT: DOMPurify is NOT a dependency in v6 (confirmed: 0 hits in package-lock.json and src). Do NOT add a markdown/linkify/sanitizer library — hand-roll a tokenizer that escapes all non-link text and only builds anchors for validated http(s) URLs. Do NOT push or open a PR.
contribution_requirements: XSS safety is mandatory: bot text comes from an external Render chat endpoint (data.answer) and is UNTRUSTED. Never {@html} raw external text. Build tokens programmatically, HTML-escape all non-link text, and only emit <a> for validated http/https URLs (reject javascript:/data:/other schemes). Anchors must be target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" (nofollow ugc acceptable). Keep svelte-check at 0/0.
key_patterns: Pure logic is extracted to a module and unit-tested in 'node' env; component behavior is pinned with a jsdom component test that mounts the real .svelte and asserts on the rendered DOM (ContributorDetail.test.ts is the template). Tailwind utility classes on markup. Comments in this repo explain WHY a fix exists and cite the audit id.

Public/frontend-v6/.github or repo .github/workflows/ci.yml (public-frontend-v6 job, 700000-byte budget at line ~317)
directory_structure: Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/{components,utils,api,stores,a11y,skins,tooling}; routes under src/routes. Chat lives in src/lib/components/Chatbot.svelte. New linkify helper should go under src/lib/chat/ (new dir) or src/lib/utils/ per the pure-helper convention.
